text: BAM share rose 0.07 percentage points over 20 hours, extending a 0.24 percentage-point rise over 7 days, with 37.6% of Solana stake now routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 26.9% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Top-node leadership changes remain whale-driven routing, not evidence of a structural rollover.
